findings.text: non-blocking: the file is edited outside the declared write paths (the dispatch fence names reckon/ledger.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py, tests/test_a_plan_write_keeps_the_ledger_index.py and the fragment) and the manifest files it under changed_paths while recording outside_scope as none; the one-line retarget is required, since the old patch of _store.advance_write_generation no longer intercepts the advance _bump_generation now makes, but a required out-of-scope change belongs in outside_scope.

non-blocking: the arm logs' `# command:` header lines (baseline.log:4, head.log:4) carry the literal placeholder `<population>` rather than the resolved test-file list, so the done_when's requirement that each arm log open with its revision and literal command is unmet in the log itself; the manifest's structured baseline_suite/after_suite commands do carry the 437/438-path literals, so the run is still reproducible from the record.

rubric_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is to give the ledger its own write generation so a plan write does not invalidate the ledger index; reckon/_store.py:1934-1993 adds the family-keyed counter and reckon/ledger.py:1200-1250 points the ledger readers at it.
VERDICT done_when: the gate is tests/test_a_plan_write_keeps_the_ledger_index.py over a 60-run ledger; the manifest records 3 passed EXIT=0 and a base-revision negative control of 1 load, and I re-ran the file at 31209a2504 and measured 3 passed.
VERDICT write_paths: the fence named reckon/ledger.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py, the new test and the fragment; the diff also edits tests/test_a_ledger_read_does_not_walk_every_run.py, which is outside it.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records complete, both suite arms as structured JSON with literal commands, the negative control log and a landing line, and names the out-of-fence test file in changed_paths.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 75fa11d2c6; four commits, five files, 277 insertions and 20 deletions, the behaviour confined to the two source files and the new test.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:205, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:251, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:279, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:294, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:819, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:1006, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:1072, reckon/budget.py:675, reckon/ledger.py:1303, reckon/ledger.py:1984
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1220 reads _store.read_ledger_write_generation, so a plan write through _store.write_plan no longer moves the generation the ledger index keys on.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: negative-control.log records the base revision 75fa11d2c6 failing with `1 load(s)` and both arm logs end EXIT=1 with 174/173 failures and 0 added ids, but the arm logs' command header carries a `<population>` placeholder.
SCORE scope_discipline: 14
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: tests/test_a_ledger_read_does_not_walk_every_run.py:208 is retargeted outside the five declared write paths while the manifest records outside_scope as none.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: reinstating the shared counter reddens tests/test_a_plan_write_keeps_the_ledger_index.py:153 with one load, and silencing advance_ledger_write_generation reddens tests/test_a_ledger_read_does_not_walk_every_run.py:211.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/_store.py:1911 refactors the existing generation helpers into _generation_path/_read_generation/_advance_generation with the surrounding docstring idiom and ruff reports no finding on the new lines.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/_store.py:1934 extends the existing per-project counter owner rather than adding a second mechanism, and I searched reckon/ for another write-generation counter and found only this one.

verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 75fa11d2c6; four commits, five files, 277 insertions and 20 deletions, splitting the generation counter into a family-keyed path (reckon/_store.py:1911-1993) and repointing the ledger readers (reckon/ledger.py:1200-1250) with the new test and an evidence fragment.
verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_plan_write_keeps_the_ledger_index.py over a 60-run ledger with no-run-file lookups and a recording stand-in for ledger.load; the manifest records 3 passed EXIT=0 at head, both population arms (174 failed at base, 173 at head, 0 added) and a base-revision negative control showing 1 load, and I re-ran the file at 31209a2504 and measured 3 passed in 17.15s.
verdicts.goal: the node goal is to give the ledger its own write generation so a plan write stops invalidating the ledger index; reckon/_store.py:1934-1993 adds a per-family counter and reckon/ledger.py:1200-1250 points ledger_generation and _bump_generation at it, leaving reckon/crew/open_run_index.py unchanged because it already keyed on ledger.ledger_generation.
verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, both suite arms as structured JSON with literal 437/438-path commands, the negative control log at negative-control.log, the ruff clause and a landing line, and its changed_paths names the out-of-fence test file.
verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths were reckon/ledger.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/crew/open_run_index.py, tests/test_a_plan_write_keeps_the_ledger_index.py and the node's fragment; the diff touches the first two, the new test and the fragment, and also retargets tests/test_a_ledger_read_does_not_walk_every_run.py, which the fence did not name.
